1. (Currently amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium consisting essentially of water__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with a __cell wall degrading__ enzyme.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more __immature plant embryos__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos in __a quiescent state__ prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __a genetic marker analysis__. 

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __genetic analysis results__. 

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __after selection based on genotype__. 

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is __performed using automated techniques__.
